correctness.rationale: Every 9-element subset of [10] is [10] minus exactly one m. For m=5, a hypothetical four increasing positive summands with largest two sum≤10 necessarily includes a pair summing to 5: if largest=4 then {1,2,3,4}; if largest in {5,6}, the other three form 3-subset of {1,2,3,4}, containing (1,4) or (2,3); if largest≥7, three smaller must be {1,2,3}. For every other missing m, explicit witness quadruples are (1,2,3,4) for m∈{1,2,8,9,10}, (1,3,4,5) for m=3, (1,2,4,5) for m=4, (1,2,3,6) for m=6, and (1,2,3,7) for m=7. Independent direct positive-integer quartet enumeration found witness counts for missing m=1..10 of [10,10,4,4,0,3,1,3,3,6]. The n≤3 cases are formally vacuous h4(n)=n+1 (no four-distinct-positive witness fits [2n]); n4=4 and n5=5, while n≥6 value 4 is properly cited rather than independently proved.
